[text speaker="Jolly"]One... two... three... four skips! The orb counted. The orb is a very serious judge.[/text]
[text]Ripples cross the whole lake, turning the morning sun into a thousand tiny festivals.[/text]
[text speaker="Jolly"]Yesterday: festival lights. Today: lake lights. I am collecting kinds of sparkle.[/text]

[text]Slowly the mist lifts. The village across the lake appears house by house, like a story being told in order.[/text]
[text speaker="Jolly"]Being a cloud was nice. Being Jolly is also nice. I can be both before breakfast.[/text]
